findings.description: Decision 58's writeup still says `nestedPackageDirs` answers it in `typescript-source.utils.ts`. This commit moved `nestedPackageDirs` out of that file into `src/adapters/git-tree.client.ts` (confirmed: `git-tree.client.ts` now defines it; `typescript-source.utils.ts` no longer contains it), but `docs/09-decisions.md` was not touched in this diff. The move is exactly the kind of relocation the commit was careful to reflect elsewhere — it updated the sibling JSDoc in `typescript-source.utils.ts` to say "from `git-tree.client.ts`" — but missed the one other place in the repo that names the old file by path. A reader following decision 58 to find `nestedPackageDirs` will land in the wrong file.

The rewritten `withoutFiles` JSDoc fixes the prior "restates the signature" nit but overreaches the other way: `withoutFiles(report, excluded)` is a generic 2-line filter over an arbitrary predicate, yet the doc bakes in one caller's vocabulary ("the ratchet reads it", "`coverableFiles` must agree") and, fact-for-fact, duplicates `rootCoverageReport`'s own docstring at its one call site (`src/adapters/typescript.adapter.ts:144-150`, which already says "restricted to the root's own files... with the same predicate as `coverableFiles`, so report and expectation cannot drift (decisions 32, 58)"). If `withoutFiles` ever gets a second, unrelated caller, this docstring becomes actively misleading about what the function does in general. Suggest either trimming this to the generic contract ("drops files matching `excluded` from the report") and letting `rootCoverageReport` carry the full WHY it already has, or keeping this one and trimming the duplication out of `rootCoverageReport` — not both in full.

`isInNestedPackage`'s doc comment was edited from `(see \`nestedPackageDirs\`)` to `(from \`git-tree.client.ts\`)`. This trades a precise pointer (the exact producer function) for a vaguer one (a whole file that also exports `committedPackageDirs`, `MANIFEST`, `LS_TREE_MAX_BUFFER`). Not wrong, just a small loss of precision with no apparent benefit. Suggest `(from \`nestedPackageDirs\` in \`git-tree.client.ts\`)` if this is going to be touched again.
